description: 英国开局 A17 — 马跳弱格强制简化

intro.popup_en:
Weak Squares, Practice 10: Ne4 and the Passed c-Pawn
After bxc3, e4 is no longer protected by a white pawn. Black occupies it with Ne4, then advances the c-pawn. After Bxc3 and Nxc3, the rook wins material on e2. A knight on a weak square becomes the trigger for a tactical combination.
intro.popup:
Ne4弱格占据+c3通路兵 练习10

bxc3后e4格无兵守护
黑Ne4强占弱格
然后c3!!通路兵推进
Bxc3 Nxc3 Rxe2!!

弱格马=战术组合的引爆点！

outro.popup_en: Summary: Ne4 occupies the weak square; c3!! creates the passed-pawn threat; Bxc3 Nxc3 Qxc3 Rxe2 wins material. The pattern is: occupy a weak square, create a passed pawn, and use it to force a tactical gain.
outro.popup:
弱格练习10小结
✅ Ne4占据e4弱格——战术基础
✅ c3!!通路兵强推——战术导火索
✅ Bxc3 Nxc3 Qxc3 Rxe2得子

弱格策略：
占据弱格→创造通路兵→强制得子！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops in the English Opening.
...Nf6 develops a knight.
c4 expands on the flank.
...e6 reinforces the center.
Nc3 develops a knight.
...Bb4 pins the knight in a Nimzo-style setup.
g3 prepares a fianchetto.
O-O secures White's king first.
Bg2 completes White's fianchetto.
...d5 occupies the center.
cxd5 exchanges pawns, leaving Black with an isolated d-pawn.
...exd5 accepts the isolated-pawn structure.
d4 challenges Black's central pawn.
...Re8 places a rook on the e-file.
O-O secures Black's king.
...Bxc3 exchanges Black's bishop for White's bishop.
bxc3 recaptures and leaves White with doubled pawns. Crucially, e4 is now unsupported by a white pawn and becomes a weak square.
moves.popup:
bxc3叠兵
重要！e4格现在无白兵守护
e4成为弱格！

moves.popup_en: ...Ne4! Black occupies the weak square before White can challenge it. White cannot drive the knight away with d3 or f3 because neither pawn has advanced.
moves.popup:
Ne4！黑马率先占弱格
注意：白方能用兵赶吗？d3/f3都没走→不能赶！

moves.popup_en: Bb2 develops the bishop but does not challenge the knight. Black's knight remains firmly established on e4.
moves.popup:
Bb2发展象
不攻Ne4，选择缓发展
但e4马依然稳稳驻扎！

moves.popup_en: ...Nd7! The knight from b8 reinforces the outpost on e4 and prepares a tactical idea.
moves.popup:
Nd7！黑马b8→d7
巩固e4马，阵型稳固
准备后续战术反击

moves.popup_en: c4! White pushes a pawn break against Black's d5-pawn, trying to disrupt the setup.
moves.popup:
c4！白方兵突破
c3→c4，挑战黑d5
试图打乱黑方阵型

moves.popup_en: ...dxc4! Black captures. The pawn's advance has left a landing square for the c-pawn to become a passed pawn.
moves.popup:
dxc4！黑方吃兵
黑方多兵
且c4格为c3通路兵留好落点！

moves.popup_en: Qc2 attacks the knight on e4 and eyes the pawn on c4, trying to regain the initiative.
moves.popup:
Qc2白后进攻
攻击e4马并眼看c4兵
白方试图夺回主动

moves.popup_en: c3!! The passed pawn advances. With the c-file cleared, White must respond to its promotion threat. This is the tactical trigger.
moves.popup:
c3!!通路兵强推！
黑方神来之笔！
c4→c3，白方c格已空
白必须应对这个通路兵！

moves.popup_en: Bxc3 is forced: the bishop captures the passed pawn, but the combination is only beginning.
moves.popup:
Bxc3！被迫吃兵
Bb2→c3，白象吃去通路兵
但这只是战术序列的开始！

moves.popup_en: ...Nxc3! The knight from e4 captures the bishop. The weak-square outpost has become the source of a tactical gain.
moves.popup:
Nxc3！战术得子！
Ne4→c3，黑马吃白象！
马换象，黑方获益！

moves.popup_en: Qxc3 recaptures the knight, but White has lost the bishop and is under pressure.
moves.popup:
Qxc3白后回补
白失去了象，局面被动
但还有一着！

moves.popup_en: ...Rxe2!! The rook invades from e8 and captures the pawn on e2, completing the material-winning combination.
moves.popup:
Rxe2!!黑车强入e2！
Re8→e2，吃掉e2兵
得子完成！黑方物质优势！

moves.popup_en: Rc1 reinforces White's defense, but Black has already won material.
moves.popup:
Rc1白方防线
车来c1稳固阵型
但黑方物质优势已建立

moves.popup_en: ...c6 consolidates and prevents White's d5-pawn from advancing. Black is materially ahead and has the advantage.
moves.popup:
c6黑方巩固！
防止白d5推进
黑方多子，优势明显
